frozen_common.legacy_scope: The historical trainer, parser, prompts, reward scale, nucleus sampling, and single update remain unchanged.
frozen_common.reward_scale_selection: The strict reward scale 26 is the fixed value 1 + 25. It is shared by every strict arm and seed.
frozen_common.source_freeze: The launcher must record and verify a separate source snapshot before any training submission.
frozen_common.strict_scope: The strict task, explicit capacities, disjoint evaluation instances, full-softmax sampling, and four update epochs define a separate protocol.
frozen_common.weight_selection: The weights 5 and 25 preserve the historical bridge and were fixed from the training design. Held-out thresholds are audit metadata only.

prelaunch_amendments.reason: Four-sequence scoring chunks reduce execution overhead while preserving the defined mean-gradient accumulation and sampled-completion budget.
prelaunch_amendments.result_selection: No training jobs or study results preceded this amendment.
prelaunch_amendments.scope: All thirty-five strict runs use the same scoring chunk size.
